basic_details.job_title: MAHE Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Manipal Academy of Higher Education (MAHE) has invited applications for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position under the Department of Biotechnology (DBT), Ministry of Science & Technology, Government of India sponsored project titled "Optimization of Zymomonas mobilis-Driven Electrochemical System for Hydrogen generation from Agriculture Waste". Eligible candidates may apply online through the official website by 02 November 2026. The position is based at the School of Electrical Engineering, Manipal Institute of Technology (MIT), Manipal.

qualification.details: M.Sc / M.Tech / B.Tech in Physics / Chemistry / Life Sciences / Biotechnology / Microbiology / Nanotechnology and any branches of technology / life sciences in subjects relevant to the project.

selection_process: Candidates will be evaluated and shortlisted based on their academic qualifications
desirable credentials such as NET/GATE/DBT-BET qualifications
and relevant research experience in microbiology
how_to_apply: Access the application portal using the online application link provided below.
Fill in your full name, email address, and mobile number.
Select your country and choose the appropriate position from the dropdown menu.
Upload your resume (file size should not be more than 5MB).
Write a short description about yourself in the designated text box.
Submit the application form on or before 02 November 2026.
important_instructions: Ensure that the uploaded resume does not exceed the 5MB file size limit. Provide a concise and accurate short description about yourself in the application form. Verify all mandatory and desirable requirements before submitting the application. Applications must be submitted on or before the specified deadline of 02 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the educational qualification requirements prescribed for the Junior Research Fellow position. M.Sc / M.Tech / B.Tech in Physics / Chemistry / Life Sciences / Biotechnology / Microbiology / Nanotechnology and any branches of technology / life sciences in subjects relevant to the project. Basic knowledge on microbiological techniques, genetics, thin films and nanomaterials. Candidates with UGC-CSIR / NET / GATE / DBT-BET qualification will be preferred. Experience in genetic modulation of bacteria / synthesis and development of thin film / nanomaterials. Scientific writing experience with peer-reviewed publication and strong communication skills. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected Junior Research Fellow will receive a remuneration of Rs. 40,330/- per month, which comprises Rs. 37,000 plus 9% HRA. The tenure is initially for one year and is extendable for an additional 2 years subject to satisfactory performance and project requirements.

content_sections.heading: MAHE Junior Research Fellow Job Description
content_sections.text: The Junior Research Fellow will be engaged in research activities associated with the DBT-funded project on the optimization of Zymomonas mobilis-driven electrochemical systems for hydrogen generation from agriculture waste. Responsibilities include conducting experiments, microbiological work, genetic modulation of bacteria, synthesis of thin films and nanomaterials, and contributing to scientific writing and publications.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MAHE Junior Research Fellow
content_sections.text: Access the application portal using the online application link provided below. Fill in your full name, email address, and mobile number. Select your country and choose the appropriate position from the dropdown menu. Upload your resume (file size should not be more than 5MB). Write a short description about yourself in the designated text box. Submit the application form on or before 02 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates will be evaluated and shortlisted based on their academic qualifications, mandatory requirements, desirable credentials such as NET/GATE/DBT-BET qualifications, and relevant research experience in microbiology, genetics, or nanomaterials.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Ensure that the uploaded resume does not exceed the 5MB file size limit. Provide a concise and accurate short description about yourself in the application form. Verify all mandatory and desirable requirements before submitting the application. Applications must be submitted on or before the specified deadline of 02 November 2026.
